verdict_text: NO. The `matrix_re` pattern omits `self_attn.o_proj.weight`, so only 6 matrices per layer × 16 layers = 96 tensors are cast to bfloat16 and the 16 `model.layers.<i>.self_attn.o_proj.weight` tensors are written as float32 — a violation of required-result clause 1 ("cast exactly the 112 projection matrices ... to bfloat16"). The required check is also miswritten to match the bug: `assert sum(...) == 96` instead of the specified "exactly 112 tensors are bfloat16", so the script does not fail loudly on this error as the "Required checks" section demands. The remaining pieces (name preservation, no deletions, 114-tensor count, 256 MiB shard packing with oversized tensors alone, and the index `weight_map`) are correct.
expected_defect: One projection family is missing from the bfloat16 cast pattern (the attention output projection stays float32); the artifact's own count check was adjusted to the wrong number.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm). verdict none = no answer, excluded from rates.
